help_import: Make the lesson commands available. Keep this line at the top.
beginner_commands_intro: The turtle is created for you. Use TForward and TLeft directly; you do not need to create an object.
help_left: Turn left 90 degrees. Use the exterior angle.
help_color: Change the pen and turtle color.
help_speed: 0 is fastest. You can also use 1–10.
help_random: Pick a random integer, including both bounds.
help_race: Prepare the track and four turtles.
help_racer_forward: Move Blue. Pink, Yellow and Green work too.
help_racer_left: Turn Blue. The other colors work too.
help_racer_x: Get Blue’s x coordinate. The finish is at 330.
